output.summary: A large deciduous tree native to the Balkans, horse-chestnut has fallen-leaf scars shaped like horseshoes with seven “nails.” Its spring flowers are usually white with yellow-to-pink markings, followed by green spiky fruits containing glossy brown conkers.
output.edibilityNote: Raw seeds, leaves, bark and flowers are toxic and should not be eaten; young, fresh seeds can cause sickness.
